description: FastAPI router module for handling data product submission and approval workflows, including creating, retrieving, validating, and approving submissions.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router object configured for submissions endpoints

methods.name: create_submission
methods.description: Creates a new submission from a draft, validates input, and triggers validation pipeline.

methods.name: get_submission
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific submission by ID, including validation status.

methods.name: trigger_validation
methods.description: Triggers validation run for a submission, creating validation jobs and quality gates.

methods.name: approve_submission
methods.description: Approves or rejects a submission with electronic signature, handling authorization and validation.
